_comment_purpose: ISH-09 (customer-provisioning-orchestration-r1 Wave 5 punchlist, 2026-08-27). Prod-environment companion of context-defaults.dev.json — the token map is identical in SHAPE (same 20 tokens sourced the same way); only the SOURCE VALUES differ per env. This file exists so a prod-only substitution regression is easy to spot in diff review, and so validate.ps1 can cross-check both dev + prod against prereqs.yaml without treating dev as canonical.
_comment_authority: spaarke-constants.yaml + SKILL.md Step 0.5b are the RUNTIME authorities — the skill actually reads those. This file is DOCUMENTATION-ONLY.

customerId.shape: kebab-case string, 3-32 chars, starts with letter

env.populatedBy: intake.schema.json controlPlaneEnv property (ISH-12 SESSION 18 rename from `environment` → `controlPlaneEnv`)

region.populatedBy: intake.schema.json region property; aliased to openAiRegion in Step 0.5b

subId.populatedBy: az account show --query id -o tsv (prod subscription context)

l2UamiPrincipalId.populatedBy: az identity show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprk-controlplane-prod-uami --query principalId

l2UamiSpId.populatedBy: az ad sp show --id {l2UamiClientId} --query id -o tsv

graphAppId.shape: Fixed Microsoft Graph appId (invariant across envs)

artifactsStorageId.populatedBy: az storage account show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprkprodartifacts --query id -o tsv

acrId.populatedBy: az acr show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprkprodacr --query id -o tsv

kvResourceId.populatedBy: az keyvault show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprk-prod-kv --query id -o tsv

adminDvUrl.populatedBy: spaarke-constants.yaml name_templates.registryDvUrl.prod (currently placeholder — not yet provisioned)
